name: fremovexattr
description: fremovexattr removes an extended attribute from an open file specified by a file descriptor. It operates similarly to removexattr but uses the file descriptor instead of a path.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the open file from which to remove the extended attribute

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the extended attribute to remove, including its namespace prefix

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The named attribute does not exist
Extended attributes are not supported by the filesystem, or are disabled
